proves.claim: A git fixture child with no git before the system one on its PATH runs by the real git path, and other commands are unchanged.

gate.io-test-child-fixture.git-runs-by-i.why: Without it every fixture git call pays two execs through the system shim.

proves.claim: A fixture whose PATH holds its own bin/git wrapper still runs that wrapper.

gate.io-test-child-fixture.a-fixture-git.why: Without it the counting and slowing wrappers in the speed and landing tests would be skipped.
